nodes.text: Let\[f(n) = \min_{i<n} (p_{n+i}+p_{n-i}),\]where $p_k$ is the $k$th prime. Is it true that\[\limsup_n (f(n)-2p_n)=\infty?\]

#454 : [ErGr80,p.90] number theory | primes Pomerance [Po79] has proved the $\limsup$ is at least $2$.
